releaseNotes:
Release v0.21.0

New Features:
- Workflow debugging: Runs window (always on top) with recorded runs, per-node attempts and retries, captured inputs, resolved parameters, outputs and errors, "Did not execute" explanations, and Show node in graph (PS-269)
- Failed nodes keep their failure details until the node succeeds or the failure is dismissed (PS-269)
- Menu: Clear debugging data removes recorded runs, captured values and retained Console logs (PS-269)
- Console: session log history with automatic reconnect, run and graph filters, search, node links, and Pause auto-scroll
- Service tray menu with service status, Restart Service and Quit Service (PS-270)

Bug Fixes:
- Throw Error messages now appear in the Console
- Frontend launches and service connections recover after a service restart (PS-270)
- Window requests wait until desktop startup completes (PS-270)
- macOS: Git libraries are bundled so the app launches without Homebrew (PS-268)
